methods_quotes.q: Each case was assigned a sample weight based on the inverse of the selection probability; these weights were summed to provide national estimates
Confidence intervals were calculated by using a direct variance estimation procedure that accounted for the sample weights and complex sample design.
Rates were calculated using the 2000 U.S. Census Bureau postcensal estimates as denominators for the respective years and categories.
Three years of data were used to provide stable rates.
Stratum-specific estimates based on unweighted counts of less than 20, a coefficient of variation of > 30%, or both, might be statistically unstable
